name: Glyph Lines
definition: Samples a vector field on a 2D grid at a fixed x-coordinate `x`, and renders each vector as a line segment (two vertices) centered at the sample point, scaled by magnitude and colored by magnitude.
summary: Glyph Lines visualizes 3D vector fields by rendering each vector as a magnitude-scaled line segment on a 2D slice, explicitly encoding direction and magnitude unlike scalar opacity methods.
